_comment: Every number the calculator uses, with its source and the date it was checked.
The calculator renders these dates on the page — an undated price is a guess.
IMPORTANT: gohighlevel.com is unreachable from the build environment, so these
were verified against multiple independent secondary sources rather than the
vendor's own pricing page. verificationMethod records that honestly. Re-check
against the vendor directly before treating any figure as authoritative.

plans.name: Starter
plans.bestFor: One business, or an agency with up to three clients testing the platform.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.bestFor: Agencies running more than three clients who want white-label and API access.

plans.name: Agency Pro (SaaS Pro)
plans.bestFor: Agencies reselling the platform as their own software with a margin on usage.

usage.smsNote: Per SMS segment. A message over 160 characters is billed as multiple segments — long messages cost more than the per-message figure suggests.
usage.emailNote: LC Email, built on Mailgun. Reported around $0.675-$1.00 per 1,000 sent depending on volume.
usage.voiceNote: Outbound voice per minute, varies by destination country.
usage.aiNote: Conversation AI is billed per message and Voice AI per minute. Heavy AI use commonly adds $30-$150/month.

sources.note: Vendor page. Corroborated by multiple independent reviews checked 2026-08-28.

sources.claim: Email metered via LC Email/Mailgun at roughly $0.675-$1.00 per 1,000
Rebilling at cost available on Unlimited; markup requires Agency Pro
sources.note: This is the decision that makes the $200/month upgrade pay or not pay.
